title: Our Eyes Are upon Thee
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who looks, and tonight Jehoshaphat teaches a frightened kingdom where to look: Scout gets lost at the market, stands still, and looks up for Dad’s red hat.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout is always looking, and tonight a whole kingdom learns where to look when it is scared. In Scout’s world today: Scout is at the busy Saturday market with Dad. Scout stops to watch a man juggle apples, and when Scout turns around, Dad is gone. There are so many people! Scout’s tummy feels tight. Then Scout remembers what Dad always says: “If you get lost, stand still and look for my red hat.” So Scout stands still and looks up. There is the red hat, waving above the crowd, coming straight toward Scout. Just like Jehoshaphat, Scout learned that when you don’t know what to do, you stand still and look to the One who is coming for you, and God always is.
